text: 74-year-old male. The patient presents with sudden onset of abdominal pain around the umbilicus 16 hours ago, with recent history of hospitalization for an acute myocardial infarction a week ago. Reports several episodes of bloody loose bowel movements. Denies vomiting.

speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Mesenteric Ischemia.

The CT angiography showing reduced blood flow to the mesenteric arteries, combined with your recent myocardial infarction and bloody stools, confirms this diagnosis. Given your history of heart attack, the clot likely traveled to your gut arteries. Are you currently experiencing severe pain out of proportion to your physical exam findings?
